Question
========
What distinguishes “strong” from “weak” sustainability?

Answerlist
----------
* Strong sustainability allows full substitution of natural capital.
* Weak sustainability restricts all technological innovation.
* Strong sustainability requires preserving natural capital as non-substitutable.
* Both concepts mean the same.


Solution
========
Strong sustainability assumes that certain ecological functions and natural capital stocks are critical and cannot be substituted by human-made or technological capital, whereas weak sustainability allows for substitution.

Answerlist
----------
* False
* False
* True
* False
